headline: Nut Olave Your Face Drops a 227 Nuke and McBride Gets Buried Alive
subhead: Semifinal weekend turned into a bloodbath, a coronation, and one 2.68-point heart attack that nobody asked for.
matchOfTheWeek: Egbukkake outlasted QAmon by a whopping 2.68 points in a game that should've been a bloodbath the other way — Tyjae Spears dropped 21.5 on KyleDech's bench while he started ghosts. Chase Brown's 32.9 saved szara's entire season, and somehow ShAmon-Ra and Tiny-Handed Vampire couldn't bail Kyle out. The closest game of the week, the most painful loss of the year — that's a hall-of-fame coin flip.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime. Nut Olave Your Face hung TWO HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN POINTS on McBridesStrangeWhiteHock, a 130-point margin that should be reported to The Hague. Better than Bo went off for 36.8, Madison Beer's side piece dropped 30.2, and Mustard added 29.8 — meanwhile LargestOfRocks mustered 97.2 like he was trying to lose on purpose. Nick hit 95.3% lineup efficiency in a semifinal. Disgusting. Beautiful. Disgusting.

OnlyFants quietly put up 215 because Cubby just casually started Brock Purdy (31.9), Ashton Jeanty (31.8), AND Trevor Lawrence (31.16) in the same lineup. That's not a fantasy team, that's a cheat code. Rub My Chubb scored 151 and still lost by 64 — BigD, you played fine, you just ran into a buzzsaw wearing a thong.

Browning Out rode Puka Nacua's 46.5-point apocalypse to dump 193 on Christian McCalfinjury, who got 32.6 from his namesake CMC and still couldn't crack 142. Matt also left Romeo Doubs and his 19.4 rotting on the pine. The injury jokes write themselves at this point.

T swift's Baddies beat The Good Ladds 135-111, but let's not pretend this was clean — Tnicolle left 56.64 points on the bench, including Alec Pierce's 24.6 and Chig Okonkwo's 19.4. You won by 24 with a lineup that should've scored 192. That's like winning a fistfight with both hands tied behind your back and then bragging about it. Mig, meanwhile, watched Stefon Diggs drop 22.8 on his bench while 3rd Overall Somehow did 3rd Overall Somehow things.

And then there's Stroud Boys. 73.98. Lowest score of the week. Money Mill$ couldn't even buy a touchdown. Bjewett, your season ended with a whimper, a fart, and a Davis Mills box score. Little Peckers happily collected the W on cruise control.

powerRankings.blurb: Just dropped 227 in a semifinal at 95% efficiency — the rest of the league is playing for second.
Three QBs over 31 in a SuperFlex league is straight-up illegal in 38 states.
Puka Nacua just put up 46.5 and Patrick is one win from a chip — terrifying timing.
Won by 2.68 with Tyjae Spears decomposing on the bench, which is somehow extremely on-brand.
Left 56 points on the bench AND still won — imagine if Tnicolle ever set a lineup on purpose.
Beat the league's corpse by 52, which is like flexing for winning a footrace against a folding chair.
Lost by 2.68 with 21 points on the bench — Kyle, that's not bad luck, that's a self-inflicted wound.
CMC dropped 32.6 and Matt still got smoked by 50 — the team name remains undefeated.
Diggs put up 22.8 from the bench while none of the Jaydens 1-3 showed up to work.
Scored 151 and lost by 64 — sometimes the dice just hate you, BigD.
Just got 130-burgered in an elimination game; the autopsy will take weeks.
73.98. In Week 16. With Money Mill$ at the helm. The Prodigal Son ain't walking through that door.
